# cp-mc Monte Carlo generator psp103_nqs preload probe 20261124-235121-d0a486d-dirty

**Result (probe, simulated not measured): the CP Monte Carlo request generated by `sim/cp-mc/make_request.py` dropped `pspnqs103va` model cards: the single-sample probe request (mos_tt_mismatch, 27 C, 3.300 V, seed 1) logged 46 `Unknown model type pspnqs103va - ignored` lines with the generator as tracked and 0 after adding `psp103_nqs.osdi` to its `osdi_preload` (the only generator change). Both runs completed (`ngspice-47 done`, `.meas` values returned).**

- **Scope**: issue #451 accounting for the CP candidate `sim/cp-mc/make_request.py` (the nominal and negative-control drivers' request generator).
- **Method**: `python3 sim/cp-mc/make_request.py --cp-netlist design/netlist/cp.spice --outdir <scratch> --probe --n 1 --seed 1` (the issue test plan's invocation) into a fresh directory per side, `options.keep_artifacts` set on the scratch request, then `klt sim <scratch>/request.json --backend local -o <fresh dir>`. Count = `Unknown model type` lines in the fresh per-corner `ngspice.log`. The single-sample mismatch limit verdict is not evidence either way and is ignored; both runs' measurement stages ran to completion.
- **Regeneration check (issue #451 AC-3)**: a semantic diff of the regenerated request against the baseline request shows exactly one difference, the added `options.osdi_preload[1]` entry `$PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi/psp103_nqs.osdi` (corners, seeds, netlists, measurements and all other options identical).
- **Simulator**: `ngspice-47` (`/home/ubuntu/.local/bin/ngspice`, binary sha256 `39ca1adb826660324c3626f72bd946ec40704f0f3fc8e243c623f76e24b3eee2`), one local `klt sim` per run, `OMP_NUM_THREADS=2`.
- **PDK**: IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0, `PDK_ROOT=/home/ubuntu/share/pdk`; `cornerMOShv.lib` and its mismatch libs, `psp103.osdi` and `psp103_nqs.osdi` hash-match `sim/pins.json`.
- **Commit**: `d0a486d-dirty` of this repository (worktree of issue #451; the generator differs from HEAD only by this fix)
